title: EtaleResolutionSectionCanonicalTransfer
statement: Let $g:Y\to X$ be a scheme morphism, $G$ an abelian etale sheaf on $X$, $I$ an injective resolution of $G$, and $J$ an injective resolution of $g^{-1}G$. Suppose $\alpha:I\to g_*J$ is a chain map with $I.\iota^0\alpha^0=\eta_{g,G}g_*(J.\iota^0)$. Let $c_X,c_Y$ be normalized comparisons for these two resolutions [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-canonical-comparison]. Then they carry the global section transfer of $\alpha$ to $\operatorname{cohomologyMap}(g)$ and the open section transfer over each $W\subseteq X$ to $\operatorname{openCohomologyPullback}(g,W)$, with its prescribed coefficient transport [def-weil-pbc-etale-resolution-section-transfer], [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Only these two transfer identities are asserted; no comparisons are constructed and no restriction identities are asserted.

source.place: Tag 0A50, sections of an injective resolution; Tag 03F3 (2), localization; Tag 01F8 and Remark 01FB, functoriality via resolutions. Read the corresponding Stacks tag pages; cocycle expansion of the parent proof, written by W3.

proof.text: Adjoint alpha to beta from the inverse image of I to J. Exactness of inverse image makes its source a resolution, and the augmentation equation says beta preserves this augmentation. The derived-category formula for extMk or homotopy independence of comparison lifts computes the inverse-image Ext class by beta applied to the pulled-back cocycle.

Evaluation of this cocycle at 1 is alpha at the terminal etale object followed by terminalSectionPullback, the global section transfer. On W use the free representable and identity generator; unit naturality and inverse-image composition give the specified open coefficient transport and openSectionPullback. Apply both comparison normalizations and the surjectivity of homology pi to obtain the global and open identities.

lean.statement: theorem resolutionSection_canonical_transfer {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (I : InjectiveResolution G) (J : InjectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G)) (α : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex) (hα : I.ι.f 0 ≫ α.f 0 = (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).unit.app G ≫ (lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).map (J.ι.f 0)) (cX : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison G I) (cY : ResolutionSectionCanonicalComparison ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj G) J) : (∀ q x, cY.globalEquiv q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (globalResolutionSectionTransfer g I.cocomplex J.cocomplex α) q x) = cohomologyMap g G q (cX.globalEquiv q x)) ∧ (∀ W q x, cY.openEquiv (g ⁻¹ᵁ W) q (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (openResolutionSectionTransfer g I.cocomplex J.cocomplex α W) q x) = openCohomologyPullback g W G q (cX.openEquiv W q x))
